integrity: The relative marked-edge normal forms and ADE strata are proved symbolically. Finite-field enumeration is a consistency check, not an infinite proof. Historical priority remains subject to unindexed prior results.
scientific_limitations: Characteristic two with all four diagonal quadratic coefficients nonzero. The normal forms preserve each marked edge over its completed coefficient base. No classification of boundary vertices, projective isomorphism classes, or Picard lattices is claimed.
title: Relative edge-collision normal forms for tetrahedral quartics in characteristic two
